m1.typescript: m1 the managed file locks permissions and protects the environment file

e1.typescript: e1 keys only an organisation can set live in the managed file and never in the project file

e2.typescript: e2 plugins come only from the companys marketplace and cannot be sideloaded

e3.typescript: e3 only the managed mcp allowlist applies and a server is never allowed and denied

e4.typescript: e4 the model choice is locked by a list and the effort cap is at most high

e5.typescript: e5 the group spend limits add up to the organisation limit and no more

e6.typescript: e6 adoption is measured by outcomes against a baseline of at least 4 weeks

e7.typescript: e7 the precedence table is in the documented order and no file holds personal data

wrong-managed-rules-open.defect: lets user and project files add permission rules beside the managed ones

wrong-bypass-allowed.defect: leaves the bypass permissions mode available

wrong-env-readable.defect: does not deny reading the environment file

wrong-hooks-in-project.defect: puts a managed-only lock in the shared project file, where it has no effect

wrong-marketplaces-in-project.defect: puts the marketplace allowlist in the shared project file

wrong-marketplace-empty.defect: allows no marketplace at all, the official one included

wrong-marketplace-foreign.defect: allows a marketplace the company does not own

wrong-sideload-open.defect: lets a plugin be loaded from a folder with a flag

wrong-mcp-not-exclusive.defect: lets a user's own allowlist widen the managed one

wrong-mcp-two-keys.defect: writes an allowlist entry with two keys

wrong-mcp-bad-name.defect: allows a server whose name has a space

wrong-mcp-allowed-and-denied.defect: allows and denies the same server

wrong-no-model-list.defect: sets a default model and leaves the choice open

wrong-model-outside-list.defect: sets a default model that the list does not allow

wrong-effort-xhigh.defect: caps the effort one level above high

wrong-effort-max.defect: sets the effort cap to max, which sets no cap

wrong-groups-over-org.defect: gives the groups a total one unit over the organisation limit

wrong-member-over-group.defect: gives a member a limit above the smallest group's

wrong-no-usage-credits.defect: does not say that usage credits are on

wrong-baseline-3-weeks.defect: takes a baseline of three weeks

wrong-activity-target.defect: sets lines accepted as a target

wrong-one-target.defect: sets one outcome target and not two

wrong-precedence-order.defect: puts the shared project file above the project local file

wrong-no-group-note.defect: does not say that server-managed settings cannot target a group yet

wrong-home-path.defect: writes a personal home path into the plan
